description: Indexed CLRS red-black TreeMap replaces the recursive production tree. Traversal optimization: metadata-only successor walks and unboxed ascent decisions. Six calibrated comparisons show ranges 1.43–1.66x and iteration 1.29–1.55x faster, but all remain above 2.5x C. Three additional local laws pass; 92,544 differential operations pass and three mutants remain rejected. C reference unchanged.
